name: Keeby
soft_passes: #1 mask discipline — keycap silhouette reads as a squircle and fills the frame (good Dock conformance), but delivered as a free object on transparency with baked gloss/specular/skirt-shadow rather than a flat unmasked square layer for the system to light
#3 silhouette test — solid-black fill reads only as a generic rounded square/keycap; the differentiating cream smiley is interior and vanishes in pure silhouette
failures: #10 variant robustness — opaque single-object baked render with no separable foreground layer; cannot be re-lit/re-tinted, so dark/clear/tinted macOS 26 renders collapse it to a flat monochrome rounded-square+smiley, losing gloss, depth and orange identity

palette.background: transparent / none — free keycap object (corners alpha-0); the keycap crown itself is a ramp #FFB057->#F9770A, skirt #EC6A0B->#711D03
palette.accent: none (single orange hue family; specular hotspot #FFFFFF)

light_model: top-left key light, glossy plastic; tight speculars blown to #FFFFFF on the crown plus a bright top-rim band, soft falloff down the domed face, skirt side-walls recede into #711D03 bottom-right — one coherent light, all baked in (not system-applied)
layer_stack: specular gloss highlights (crown hotspot + top rim)
devices: keycap-as-icon (the app's whole subject is one literal keycap)
embossed smiley on the crown (tool becomes a friendly character)
candy-gloss injection-moulded ABS plastic (blown-white specular + hard rim)
visible keycap skirt selling real 3D depth (not a flat rounded square)
rhymes_hint: glossy 3D single-object render icons (Spline/Blender indie wave, claymorphism-adjacent) and playful/toy single-glyph icons; the embossed-friendly-face-on-object motif — a committed toy/glossy family, not the flat pro-utility glyph its category would predict
notes: 312x312 WebP web render, no 1024 master — flat-face hex and gloss ramp reliable, fine gloss micro-gradients and emboss depth soft. Transparency genuine (all corners alpha-0), consistent with a rounded-square keycap silhouette; near-full-frame so low Dock-reading risk regardless. Strong brand coherence: same orange + cream carries the cover wordmark, download-button accent, app gradient and menu-bar glyph. Shares the transparent-free-object + baked-lighting + #10-fail structure with AutoShelf but conforms to the mask far better (fills frame as squircle vs floating ~52% width); candidate seed for a 'glossy-3D-render object' icon cluster distinct from 'floating-object utility'.
